body:
## Pull request overview

This PR restructures documentation to clearly distinguish plugin-based widgets from core components and adds foundational architecture and layout guides to help developers understand and use ObjectUI’s monorepo and runtime correctly.

**Changes:**
- Updated navigation metadata so all plugin packages have entries under `content/docs/plugins/`, and moved calendar-view/chatbot/timeline docs out of the “complex components” section.
- Added new guide pages for architecture and layout, and wired them into the `guide` docs menu along with the existing `fields` guide.
- Removed miscategorized complex component docs for plugin-driven widgets now documented under the plugins section.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `content/docs/plugins/meta.json` | Ensures all plugin packages (including calendar-view, dashboard, form, grid, view) appear in the plugins docs navigation, aligning docs IA with the plugin packages in `packages/`. |
| `content/docs/guide/meta.json` | Adds `architecture`, `layout`, and `fields` to the guide navigation so the new conceptual docs are discoverable. |
| `content/docs/guide/layout.md` | Introduces a dedicated layout guide for AppShell, Page, PageHeader, and SidebarNav, but the documented installation and JSON schema APIs currently diverge from the actual `@object-ui/layout` implementation and `@object-ui/types` definitions. |
| `content/docs/guide/architecture.md` | Adds an architecture overview covering monorepo topology, schema rendering, registries, expressions, styling, and plugins, though a few constraints (e.g., types’ dependencies and inline style rules) are inconsistent with the current codebase and with other parts of the same document. |
| `content/docs/components/complex/meta.json` | Removes `calendar-view`, `timeline`, and `chatbot` from the complex components menu so they are only presented via the plugin docs, keeping core component docs focused on non-plugin features. |
| `content/docs/components/complex/chatbot.mdx` (deleted) | Removes the chatbot demo from the complex components section, avoiding duplicate/conflicting docs for a plugin-provided widget now documented under `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`. |
| `content/docs/components/complex/calendar-view.mdx` (deleted) | Removes the calendar-view complex component docs, deferring to the plugin calendar/calendar-view documentation in the plugins section. |
| `content/docs/components/complex/timeline.mdx` (deleted) | Removes the timeline complex component docs, deferring to the dedicated plugin timeline documentation. |
</details>

The Installation section implies that the layout package is bundled with `@object-ui/react` ("included in the core ObjectUI installation" and showing `npm install @object-ui/react`), but `@object-ui/layout` is a separate package and `@object-ui/react` does not depend on it (`packages/layout/package.json` vs `packages/react/package.json`). This will mislead users trying to install the layout system; please update the instructions to show the correct package to install (e.g. `npm install @object-ui/layout` or a documented umbrella package) and clarify when layout components are actually auto-registered.

The `AppShell` Schema API and JSON examples here document a schema with `type: 'app-shell'` plus `header`, `sidebar`, `body`, and `sidebarCollapsible/sidebarDefaultOpen` fields, but there is no corresponding `AppShell` schema defined in `@object-ui/types` (no `'app-shell'` entry in `SchemaRegistry`), and the `AppShell` React component currently only accepts `sidebar`, `navbar`, `children`, `className`, and `defaultOpen` props. As a result, the documented JSON configuration will not be type-checked or wired through by `SchemaRenderer` as shown; please either align the documentation with the current implementation (describing how to use `AppShell` from React code), or update the types/registry and component props so this documented schema shape actually works.

This `Page` Schema API introduces fields like `breadcrumbs`, `actions`, `maxWidth`, `padding`, `headerClassName`, and `bodyClassName`, but the actual `PageSchema` in `@object-ui/types` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts` and `layout.zod.ts`) only defines `title`, `icon`, `description`, `body`, `children`, and `regions`. The current `Page` renderer in `packages/layout/src/Page.tsx` also only reads `schema.title`, `schema.description`, and `schema.children`, ignoring `body` and these additional properties, so the documented JSON examples here won’t behave as described; please either narrow the docs to the supported fields or extend `PageSchema` and the renderer so these options are truly available.

The `PageHeader` section documents a JSON schema with `type: 'page-header'` and top-level `title`, `description`, `breadcrumbs`, and `actions` fields, but the current implementation in `packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx` only consumes React props (`title`, `description`, `action`, `children`, `className`) and does not read from `schema`, and there is no typed `PageHeader` schema in `@object-ui/types`. With the current `SchemaRenderer`, top-level fields like `title` and `breadcrumbs` on the schema will be ignored unless they are nested under `schema.props`; please either adjust the examples to match the real prop shape (via `props`) or extend the layout types and component so this documented schema shape is actually supported.

This `SidebarNav` section describes a JSON-driven component with `type: 'sidebar-nav'`, nested `items` (with badges, nested groups, active/disabled flags, and `collapsible/defaultOpen` props), but there is no `sidebar-nav` entry in the schema registry/types and `packages/layout/src/SidebarNav.tsx` only accepts a flat `items: NavItem[]` (title, href, optional icon) plus `title` and `className`. As written, the documented schema cannot be rendered via `SchemaRenderer` and the extra fields like `badge`, nested `items`, or `collapsible` are not supported by the current component; please update the docs to reflect the actual `SidebarNavProps` shape (used directly in React) or extend the implementation/types before publishing this schema API.

In this "❌ Forbidden" list, inline styles are described as disallowed "except for dynamic values" (line 299), but the later "Tailwind Only" section explicitly says "Never use inline styles or CSS-in-JS" and shows `<div style={{ backgroundColor: 'red' }}>` as a hard "bad" example. These two statements conflict and can confuse readers about whether any inline `style={{}}` usage is acceptable; please pick a single rule (likely: no inline styles at all) and update one of these sections so the styling guidance is self-consistent.
```suggestion
- Inline styles (`style={{}}`)
```

The `@object-ui/types` section says the package has a constraint of "ZERO dependencies, no React code", but the current `packages/types/package.json` declares runtime dependencies on `@objectstack/spec` and `zod`. Unless the intent is specifically "no React / UI dependencies" rather than literally zero deps, this wording is inaccurate; please clarify the constraint (for example, "no React or UI-library dependencies") or adjust the package configuration to match the documented guarantee.
```suggestion
- **Constraint**: No React or UI-library dependencies; only protocol-level deps (e.g. `@objectstack/spec`, `zod`)
```
